review.conclusion_reason: NO and the asserted end no later than September 7, 1974 are unsupported under rule (b): the interment event has not been verified. Funeral attendance and a Temporary finding-aid label do not close that gap. The defensible operative assessment is OPEN pending verified interment evidence and an accepted original. Formal status can be reported only as no express ending found in the checked material, not proof that none exists.
review.stop_code_verdict: confirmed: TOOL_DEFECT fits the first gap. The held extraction selected an unrelated rules page, and opening the cited official PDF failed because its content length exceeds the web tool limit. The accepted original remains unexamined.
review.suspected_defect: The categorical NO and ended clause states contradict the worker's acknowledged unverified interment evidence. This looks like an unsupported promotion of provisional leads into a final ending determination; deliberate intent cannot be established.

verdicts.reason: Read the entire named held FR extraction. It contains Corps of Engineers and EPA rules, including the quoted Part 327 heading, but no EO 11802.
The named APP file contains the quoted half-staff command and 'until the day of interment'. This confirms transcription text only.
The named APP file contains the quoted command for facilities abroad 'during this same period', including military facilities and naval vessels and stations.
The cited NARA page's EO 11802 entry gives '39 FR 32111; September 5, 1974' and lists no amendment or revocation. That omission establishes only what this table lists.
Page 1 of the cited diary, dated September 6, 1974, records the quoted funeral attendance. Its header also says THURSDAY. The entry documents funeral services, not interment.
The cited Bentley page returns 403. Neither the purported quotation nor the burial date could be confirmed; the worker correctly labels this an unchecked lead.
The cited General Orders page is inaccessible through the tool. The quotation cannot be confirmed and, as presented, describes a planned interment rather than completed performance.
The supplied evidence slice explicitly gives disposition 'Temporary'. Upheld only as a description of that slice, not independent verification of the underlying OFR table or an ending date.
